nightmare noun

Traupman 351

somnium turbulentum

Neither this nor somnium terrificum has an ancient citation.

Examples

  • nec … pavor quiētōs suscitet

    that no fright wake us at rest (Ambrose’s hymn prays)Ambrose’s hymn
